question.en-US: Each ball speed has a specific characterization:

en-US: 1 – The ball bounces 3 times before reaching the back glass; 2 – The ball bounces 2 times before reaching the back glass; 3 – The ball bounces once before the back glass and rebounds up to the baseline; 4 – The ball bounces once before reaching the back glass; 5 – The ball bounces once before the back glass and rebounds far past the white line after hitting the glass
